# Harness compatibility

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-compatibility.sh from docs/compatibility.tsv. -->

Support is version-specific. `yes` means that exact path is present for the
named version; it does not imply live acceptance of every behavior. Native
observers contribute evidence only. None of them delivers a message inside a
harness in this release.

| Harness | Version | PTY profile | Native observer | Native delivery | Notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---|
| Claude Code | `2.1.280` | yes | hooks | no | Measured PTY profile; observe-only hooks. |
| Claude Code | `2.1.316` | unmeasured | mod | no | Observe-only mod; no measured PTY profile. |
| Muse Code | `1.4.13-R6996.1` | yes | native plugin | no | Measured PTY profile and observe-only plugin. |
| Muse Code | `1.4.14-R7309.1` | yes | fallback PTY | no | Measured PTY profile; the plugin handshake is pinned to 1.4.13 and fails closed to PTY evidence. |
| Codex | `0.154.0` | yes | hooks | no | Measured PTY profile; observe-only hooks. |
| OpenCode | `1.18.29` | yes | native-events plugin | no | Measured PTY profile and observe-only plugin. |
| Antigravity | `1.4.8` | yes | hooks | no | Measured PTY profile; observe-only hooks. |

The source table is intentionally explicit rather than inferred from a
harness name. A profile or observer is enabled only after its own version
handshake succeeds. An unknown version falls back to observation/manual paths
and is never silently treated as safe for automatic terminal delivery.
